position_lane_semantics.signal_eligibility_rule: signal_window_end_msc >= prior_accepted_exit_time_msc is required; a signal timestamp strictly earlier than the prior accepted exit is skipped even if its first eligible quote arrives later.
position_lane_semantics.unresolved_exit_rule: An exit quote timeout leaves the lane unresolved and blocks all later signals in that lane for the remainder of that session.
position_lane_semantics.entry_timeout_rule: An entry quote timeout does not open a position and does not block later signals.
position_lane_semantics.reset_rule: Each lane resets at each session boundary; no open position or feature history carries across sessions.
position_lane_semantics.live_execution_warning: Independent horizon lanes are analytical counterfactuals, not simultaneous executable positions. Any later execution design must enforce one account-level position across all enabled strategies and horizons.

evaluation.entry_quote: First quote strictly after signal-window end; maximum delay 5000ms inclusive.
evaluation.exit_quote: First quote at or after entry time plus horizon; maximum delay 2000ms inclusive.
evaluation.spread_treatment: Executable-side crossing includes spread exactly once.
evaluation.sample_gate: At least 100 accepted non-overlapping outcomes per configuration/horizon across at least four distinct prospective dates.

freeze_contract.timestamp_rule: The freeze commit timestamp must precede the earliest start of every v2 validation collection session.

gates.holdout: SEALED; requires a later independently reviewed selection-freeze protocol and must not reuse v1 holdout artifacts

limitations: The four v1 validation sessions were already evaluated and are prohibited from corrected-performance rescoring.
